bible: Visual Style: Chunky, colorful 3D claymation aesthetic with expressive cartoon eyes, playful physics, and vibrant desert-canyon landscapes. Characters: Barnaby the Bulldozer (cheerful, heavy yellow bulldozer with big expressive headlight eyes), Pip the Pigeon (clever, hyperactive purple pigeon with aviator goggles), and Rocco the Raccoon (smug, competitive raccoon driving a tiny cherry-red go-kart).

episodes.title: Can A Bulldozer Really Bounce Across?
episodes.recap: Barnaby the Bulldozer attaches giant springs to leap across Muddy Canyon, but an ominous shadow awaits his landing.
